abort.already_configured: JP Wireless Chime is already configured.

init.title: JP Wireless Chime options
init.description: Add or remove receive/send chime buttons.

add_receive.title: Add receive button
add_receive.description: Register a physical wireless chime button as an event entity. Use * or leave blank to match any channel, melody, or receiver.

remove_receive.title: Remove receive button/device
remove_receive.description: Remove a registered receive button, including its device and event entity.

add_send.title: Add send button
add_send.description: Register a send button entity for transmitting a configured wireless chime signal.

remove_send.title: Remove send button/device
remove_send.description: Remove a registered send button, including its device and button entity.

error.no_receive_buttons: There are no registered receive buttons.
error.no_send_buttons: There are no registered send buttons.
